phases.name: Runtime Validation
phases.description: Optional manual runtime testing if app can be launched

subtasks.description: Manual test: Create a scrapnote block in editor

verification.instructions:
1. Run app with 'flutter run -d chrome'
2. Open note editor
3. Insert scrapnote block template (:::scrapnote)
4. Add '@el' lines
5. Verify ElementCard widgets render
6. Check placeholder for invalid element IDs

subtasks.expected_output: Screenshots or confirmation that scrapnote blocks render correctly in the editor

ScrapnoteBlock extends BlockDefinition with all required properties
@el id lines are parsed and rendered as ElementCard widgets
Missing elements show 'Element not found' placeholder
verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk verification task - checking implementation completeness without modifying code. Static analysis and file checks are sufficient.
